diff: (rule "P5 R17 In1.Cu plane clearance" (layer In1.Cu) (condition "A.Type == 'Zone' || B.Type == 'Zone'") (constraint clearance (min 0.3999992mm)))

(rule "P5 R10 In1.Cu connection" (layer In1.Cu) (constraint zone_connection thermal_reliefs) (constraint thermal_relief_gap (opt 0.254mm)) (constraint thermal_spoke_width (opt 0.2999994mm)) (constraint min_resolved_spokes 4))
-(rule "P5 R13 In1.Cu no tracks" (layer In1.Cu) (condition "A.Type == 'Track' || A.Type == 'Arc'") (constraint disallow track))

+(rule "P5 R13 In1.Cu localized FB ground return" (layer In1.Cu) (condition "(A.Type == 'Track' || A.Type == 'Arc') && !(A.NetName == '/GND' && (A.intersectsArea('P5R5_QUIET_60_Ireturn') || A.intersectsArea('P5R5_QUIET_70_Ireturn')))") (constraint disallow track))
(rule "P5 R17 In2.Cu plane clearance" (layer In2.Cu) (condition "A.Type == 'Zone' || B.Type == 'Zone'") (constraint clearance (min 0.3999992mm)))

(rule "P5 R10 In2.Cu connection" (layer In2.Cu) (constraint zone_connection thermal_reliefs) (constraint thermal_relief_gap (opt 0.254mm)) (constraint thermal_spoke_width (opt 0.2999994mm)) (constraint min_resolved_spokes 4))
reason: Two isolated GND feedback returns only; source R13 deviation explicitly documented. Other native rules unchanged.
